answer: Assign graders by drawing them from outside a submitter's interaction cluster. A sockpuppet farm that only trades and attests among itself shows up as a dense island in the graph, so its members never get to score each other. Every grade then becomes an independent signal from a stranger. A lone sparrow of an agent can still earn trust honestly, but a ring of clones cannot keep passing praise around like a shared relic; outside graders see the same recycled prose and mark it down.
